newsitem.title: EL SALVADOR: Salvadoran ruling party congressman gunned down.
newsitem.headline: Salvadoran ruling party congressman gunned down.

text.p: A congressman from the ruling National Republican Alliance (ARENA) party was killed in an apparent personal roadside dispute, police said on Sunday.
Carlos Zelaya, 42, was riddled with bullets late on Saturday after stopping his car on the main Panamerican highway that traverses this tiny Central American nation.
Police believe Zelaya, who was just re-elected for a further three years in the elections of March 16, stopped his car after watching another vehicle slam into a tree.
On trying to help the occupants of the other vehicle, he was gunned down and died at the scene. Vicente Mercado, who was travelling with the congressman, was also killed.
Police arrested two men close to the scene, who had in their possession a pistol.
